newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius' UBP interim profit up 45 percent.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius' UBP interim profit up 45 percent.

text.p: Building materials manufacturer United Basalt Products on Friday reported a 45 percent rise in interim profit before tax to 28.7 million rupees ($1.43 million) for the half year ended 31 December 1996 from 19.8 million rupees during the same period in 1995.
"The group has operated under favourable conditions during the first semester of the financial year and has realised better results than expected," said company secretary Gaetan Bouic.

UBP's turnover for the six months period ending 31 December 1996 was posted at 244.0 million rupees from 222.4 million rupees during the second half of 1995 while profit after tax rose to 25.6 million rupees from 17.9 million rupees.
"The second semester is well known to be less profitable than the first. However, the directors are confident of a better than average result for the full financial year," Bouic said.
